author: SpaceNightrider
body:
I'm guessing this is where I post appeals. I haven't used this site before and it's been a long time since I played on the server.

Anyways I joined back in Nebula after not having played it for months. I got to a few rounds in and then I was suddenly banned for hacking? Specifically Anti-Knockback and No Slowdown.

I just want to say that I was not hacking and I have no idea why anyone thought that I was. Why is it that on my first day back I get instantly banned for nothing? :( I've played Nebula a lot, but that was months ago. I've never hacked and have never been accused unless it was someone getting mad that I killed them. Today when I played I joined and played normally, again not hacking (and I don't ever hack). I was just playing with my friend. I did hear that another player in the server was using kill aura, however. I never saw him banned, yet I'm banned for not hacking?

My IGN is SpaceNightrider. I wish to get my account unbanned from Nebula. Thanks.
